snippet.title: Little Michael knew What was Coming... 😭💀 #michaeljackson #shorts
snippet.description:
Little Michael Jackson already had the weight of the world on his tiny shoulders. Behind that legendary, angelic smile and unbelievable childhood talent was a little boy who lived in constant fear. Michael often shared how terrified he was of his father, Joe Jackson—how one missed step or one forgotten lyric during rehearsals could mean harsh punishment. He worked tirelessly not just because he was gifted, but because he had to be perfect to survive those grueling sessions. Looking back at young Michael now hits so differently when you know the fear and discipline behind his greatness. King of Pop, forever and always.
